items.item: Stage columns run in hiring order (such as Applied → Screening → Interview → Offer → Hired), and rejected or withdrawn candidates are kept out of the active columns, in a separate collapsed column or behind a filter
items.evidence: STAGES = [applied, screening, interview, offer, hired, rejected] with rejected flagged `collapsible: true`; board renders it collapsed by default (`state.rejectedCollapsed = true`) as a narrow w-16 column with an expand button, separate from the active columns.

items.item: Each stage header shows a candidate count that matches the number of cards in that column under the current filters
items.evidence: renderBoard builds `byStage` from `filtered` candidates; `const count = list.length` is rendered directly in the column header (`<h2 id="col-${s.id}">...${limitText}`), so it always reflects the filtered cards shown below it.

items.item: The page names the opening being shown (job title, department, positions to fill and hired so far, such as "Senior Accountant · Finance · 1 of 2 hired"), and a selector switches to another opening
items.evidence: jobMetaLine only renders `${job.dept} · ${job.location} · Open since ${fmtDate(job.openSince)} · ${total} candidates` — JOB_OPENINGS has no headcount/hired fields and no 'X of Y hired' is shown anywhere. The #jobSelect dropdown does switch openings, but the required hired-so-far framing is missing.

items.item: Each card gives the candidate's name, application source and days in the current stage, and candidates who have stayed past a stated limit are flagged with a text label or icon rather than colour alone
items.evidence: renderCardHtml: `tagHtml = c.rating ? ratingBadge : ${c.source}` — once a candidate has a rating the source badge is replaced and no longer shown. cardMetaLine only expresses 'days in stage' for applied/screening; offer/hired/rejected cards show expiry/start-date/reason instead. (The ageing badges 'No update N days' / 'Over limit' / 'Expires in N days' do use text, not colour alone, for the over-limit flag.)

items.item: A card can change stage without dragging, through a "Move to" menu or buttons that work from the keyboard, and each move is announced through an aria-live region
items.evidence: Kebab button opens a 'Move to' menu (`data-kebab` → openKebabMenu, role="menuitem" items); cards also support keyboard lift/move via Space + Arrow keys + Escape in onCardKeydown. commitMove() calls `announce(...)` which writes to `<div id="liveRegion" aria-live="polite">`.

items.item: Moving a candidate to Rejected opens a confirmation that names the candidate and requires a rejection reason before it completes
items.evidence: openRejectDialog sets subtitle `Reject ${c.name}? This moves them out of the active pipeline for this opening.`; the submit handler blocks and shows `#rejectReasonError` if `!reasonEl.value`, preventing completion without a reason.

items.item: Search by candidate name or email and filters by source and by recruiter narrow the board, and the active filters are displayed with a way to clear them
items.evidence: matchesFilters() tests `foldSearch(c.name + ' ' + c.email + ' ' + c.id)`; #sourceFilter and #recruiterFilter selects filter further; renderChips() shows removable chips per active filter plus a 'Clear all' button.

items.item: Opening a card shows the candidate's contact details, a link to the CV and a stage history listing each move with its date and the person who made it
items.evidence: Contact section shows email/phone/location correctly, but the Resume 'Preview'/'Download' controls are plain buttons wired to `showToast('This is a demo — no file is attached to this candidate.')`, not an actual CV link. buildActivity() only synthesizes a single 'Advanced to X' entry for the candidate's current stage (plus rating/offer/hire/flag/reject notes), not a full list of every prior stage move with date and mover.

items.item: A stage with no candidates keeps its column and shows a placeholder such as "No candidates", and loading and error-with-retry states are built in
items.evidence:
Empty column renders `
  • No candidates in ${stage}
    • ` while the column itself stays; renderLoading() shows a skeleton board/list, and renderError() shows 'Couldn't load candidates' with a `#retryLoadBtn` wired to retryLoad().

notes: Both provided screenshots (first.png and full.png) captured the page mid-skeleton-load (the init() flow shows a ~480ms loading skeleton before the real board renders), so visual confirmation of the populated board/cards/colours was not possible from the images; findings above are based on markup/script analysis. No notable template tells (gradients, uppercase tracked labels, emoji icons, greeting headers, KPI tiles, sidebar promos, etc.) were found via source inspection — the UI is a plain, utilitarian Tailwind build.
